description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for managing and rendering a Mattermost model picker UI, including parsing commands, building views, handling session data, and managing model references.

methods.name: splitModelRef
methods.description: Parses a model reference string into provider and model components.

methods.name: normalizePage
methods.description: Normalizes a page number, defaulting to 1 if input is invalid.

methods.name: paginateItems
methods.description: Paginates an array of items based on page number and page size.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Builds a context object for a given picker state.

methods.name: buildButtonId
methods.description: Generates a unique button ID based on the picker state.

methods.name: buildButton
methods.description: Constructs a Mattermost interactive button input with specified parameters.

methods.name: getProviderModels
methods.description: Retrieves sorted list of models for a given provider from data.

methods.name: formatCurrentModelLine
methods.description: Formats a string describing the current model, or defaults if invalid.

methods.name: resolveMattermostModelPickerEntry
methods.description: Parses command text into a model picker entry type.

methods.name: parseMattermostModelPickerContext
methods.description: Parses a context object into a picker state, validating required fields.

methods.name: buildMattermostAllowedModelRefs
methods.description: Builds a set of all allowed model references from data.

methods.name: resolveMattermostModelPickerCurrentModel
methods.description: Resolves the current model string based on session data and defaults.

methods.name: renderMattermostModelSummaryView
methods.description: Creates a summary view with current model info and a button to browse providers.

methods.name: renderMattermostProviderPickerView
methods.description: Creates a view listing all providers with selection buttons.

methods.name: renderMattermostModelsPickerView
methods.description: Creates a paginated view of models for a provider with navigation and selection buttons.
